prompt: When should workers take the first meter reading?
promptZh: 工作人員何時應取得流量計的第一次讀值？

options.text: Once the test outlet has been shut.
options.whyZh: 作業說明以測試出水口關閉為第一次讀值的起點。

options.text: While the repair crew is still testing the outlet.
options.zh: 維修人員還在測試出水口時。
options.whyZh: 必須等出水口關閉後再讀，不能在測試中讀。

options.text: When the duty officer starts the morning dispatch review.
options.zh: 值班主管開始清晨的派工審查時。
options.whyZh: 清晨的派工決定在讀值記錄之後，不是首次量測的時間。

options.text: After the site contact confirms that there was planned water use.
options.zh: 場地聯絡人確認有計畫性用水之後。
options.whyZh: 正常用水若被告知就另作備註，不是開始讀值的前提。

explanationZh: 作業說明以測試出水口關閉為第一次讀值的起點。
evidence: At each site, note the flow shown on the street meter once the repair crew has closed the test outlet.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: At each site, note the flow shown on the street meter once the repair crew has closed the test outlet.

vocabulary.note: 在維修測試時讓水流出的開口。
